events.author: Dale Kent
events.name: DEFEAT

options.text: Show me how this came to pass.
Show me how history will remember these times.
I am not done with my story.
I cannot dwell on my defeat.

events.text: The court convenes one last time... to discuss the tragedy of our defeat. We tried our best to serve and protect our nation, but [rival] will go down as a minor footnote in the history of the Old World. Perhaps next time...

events.author: Solver
events.name: Demo Over
events.text: You have reached the end of the demo. Thank you for playing! In the full version of the game, you can continue this map as [rival] or choose to start a new adventure on a random or historical map. The full game also has competitive and cooperative multiplayer modes as well as extensive mod support so you can play with community-created content. We hope you enjoyed this foray into Old World and thanks again for playing!
